title: Fruit Friends
yt_description:
In this fun song, your child will learn about different types of fruits and vegetables. They will see colorful pictures and sing along with our friends. This song encourages healthy eating and exploration of new foods.

🎵 Fruit Friends

Hello
Friends
Let's eat

Carrots
Broccoli
Are good

Fruits and veggies
Are fun to eat
Every day

Fruits and veggies
Are fun to eat
Every day

Bye
Friends
Eat well

Bouncy Meadow — Kids Songs with Pip, Lulu & Bo
Animation and music created with AI tools, written and reviewed by a human.

#Shorts #KidsSongs #fruits #vegetables #healthyeating
